I rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) across all regions and opened a SEV2 incident.

**What I did:**
1. Checked `checkout-api` status — v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. Reviewed deployment history — v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release (v2.3.1 was unhealthy).
3. Rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions — verified successful.
4. Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** describing the rollback, which paged the on-call engineer.
